steps_basic.title: Create sprite
steps_basic.instruction: Open Scratch, keep or rename the cat to 'Buddy'.
steps_basic.hint: Just rename the sprite to Buddy.

steps_basic.title: Make it talk
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi! I'm Buddy!] for (2) seconds

steps_basic.title: Test it
steps_basic.instruction: Click Buddy. Does it speak? Basic complete!
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi! I'm Buddy!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: More messages
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi!] for (2) seconds
say [How are you?] for (2) seconds
say [Bye!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Costume change
steps_standard.instruction: Insert 'switch costume to costume2' between messages.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi!] for (2) seconds
switch costume to [costume2 v]
say [How are you?] for (2) seconds
say [Bye!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Add sound
steps_standard.instruction: Sounds tab → choose Pop. Add 'start sound Pop' at end.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hi!] for (2) seconds
switch costume to [costume2 v]
say [How are you?] for (2) seconds
say [Bye!] for (2) seconds
start sound [Pop v]

steps_advanced.title: Random number
steps_advanced.instruction: Set message to pick random 1 to 3.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
set [message v] to (pick random (1) to (3))

steps_advanced.title: Ask name
steps_advanced.instruction: Add 'ask [What is your name?] and wait'.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
set [message v] to (pick random (1) to (3))
ask [What is your name?] and wait

steps_advanced.title: Join answer
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
set [message v] to (pick random (1) to (3))
ask [What is your name?] and wait
say (join [Hello ] (answer)) for (2) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Random replies
steps_advanced.instruction: Add if-then for message=1, 2, 3 with different responses.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
set [message v] to (pick random (1) to (3))
ask [What is your name?] and wait
if <(message) = (1)> then
  say (join [Hello ] (answer)) for (2) seconds
else
  if <(message) = (2)> then
    say (join [Hi ] (answer)) for (2) seconds
  else
    say (join [Hey ] (answer)) for (2) seconds
